findings.title: LoggerMiddleware now silently depends on ContextualLoggerMiddleware ordering for plugin context fields
findings.body: logRequest no longer adds pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, dsUID, or traceID to the log parameters itself; it calls m.logger.FromContext(ctx) and relies on those attributes having been injected into the context by the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware. This only works if ContextualLoggerMiddleware is placed before LoggerMiddleware in the middleware chain. The coupling is implicit and unenforced: any other wiring of middlewares (tests, alternative decorator construction such as NewClientDecorator callers that build their own middleware list, or a future reordering of CreateMiddlewares) will cause 'Plugin Request Completed' log lines to silently lose all plugin/request identifying fields. Previously the traceID was also added explicitly via tracing.TraceIDFromContext; that explicit addition was removed, so traceID inclusion now depends entirely on the infra logger's FromContext behavior. Consider either keeping the fields explicit in LoggerMiddleware or documenting/asserting the ordering requirement.

findings.title: FromContext doc comment is inaccurate
findings.body: The new Logger interface method FromContext is documented as 'returns a new contextual Logger that has this logger's context plus the given context', which is the same wording as New and doesn't describe what the method actually does: it derives a logger from a context.Context (extracting contextual log attributes previously stored in that context, e.g. by log.WithContextualAttributes), and the receiver's context is not necessarily preserved (the grafanaInfraLogWrapper implementation replaces the logger entirely with the one from the context, falling back to d.New() only on type-assertion failure). The comment should describe extracting a logger from the provided context.

findings.title: No test coverage for the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware
findings.body: The PR moves the contextual-attribute injection (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname) out of the instrumentation middleware into a new ContextualLoggerMiddleware, but no test was added verifying that the middleware actually adds these attributes to the context for QueryData/CallResource/CheckHealth/CollectMetrics, including the nil-User and nil-DataSourceInstanceSettings branches. The renamed test file only updates the constructor call. A regression here would silently strip plugin-identifying fields from all downstream request logs.
